{{Top|leg}}
A '''spinal implant''' was a type of [[Cybernetics/Legends|implant]] that could be used to hack into a person's spinal cord. If the person's could no longer physically function properly due to trauma, the implant could allow them to do so for a brief period of time. Spinal implants were very dangerous, however, as they could kill the user afterward.
